effect_description_eng:
＜Armor Purge＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may trash the top card of this Digimon to prevent that deletion.)
[When Digivolving] Return 1 of your opponent's level 3, 1 of their level 4 and 1 of their level 5 Digimon to the hand.
[End of Attack] By placing this Digimon's top card as your top security card, unsuspend this Digimon or Tamer.
